message:
The other day, I found myself rummaging through the basement when I stumbled upon my old go-bag. You know, the one I packed years ago and have kept ‘just in case’? I chuckled as I pulled out items like a headlamp and a mini first-aid kit, wondering if I was perhaps a bit too prepared. I mean, who really needs three flashlights and a compass for a simple weekend getaway? 

But then I thought about how having that bag ready gives me a sense of peace, like a cozy blanket on a chilly evening. So even if I might be the gloriously over-prepared person in my family, there’s comfort in knowing I’m ready for anything, big or small. 

Have you ever found yourself over-preparing for something? It can be quite the adventure!
